correctness.rationale: Unique primitive decomposition U P D and F(z,q)=zq C(zq^2,q) give G(z,u,q)=1/(1-uF). Coefficientwise derivatives at q=u=1 yield E[A], E[R], and E[AR], hence Cov=(6*4^n/C_n-4n^2-14n-6)/(n+2). The Catalan ratio Q_n obeys Q_{n+1}=2(n+2)Q_n/(2n+1), below the polynomial supersolution for n>=2, proving strict negativity. The primitive count-conditioned mean difference is n for n>=2. Independent complete Dyck enumeration for n<=8 matched covariance, return mean and conditional gap exactly; infinite n follows from formal generating series and induction.

value.rationale: The number of visits to the hard wall is a natural excursion statistic whose relationship to total integrated height is not captured by the separate area and marginal return laws. Exact finite-n negative covariance, asymptotic -4n+6sqrt(pi n), and conditional R=1 vs R=2 gap n form a useful structural dependence statement.

limitations: Uniform finite Dyck bridges only; area sums step-start heights, and R counts all positive-time zero returns including final return. No inference to arbitrary conditioned random walks.
